Description: >
  A long folded description that goes on and on and on and on and on and on and on and on past eighty columns
Metadata:
  AWS::ServerlessRepo::Application:
    Name: app
    ReadmeUrl: README.md
    LicenseUrl: s3://x/LICENSE
Conditions:
  IsProd: !Equals [!Ref Env, prod]
Resources:
  Api:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Api
    Properties:
      DefinitionUri: api.yaml
      Enabled: yes
      Quoted: 'yes'
      Num: 0x1F
      F: 1.50
      Neg: -3
      Unicode: "café ☃"
      Multi: |
        line1
        line2
      Empty: ''
      Star: '*'
      Colon: 'a: b'
      Body:
        Fn::Transform:
          Name: AWS::Include
          Parameters:
            Location: inc.yaml
  Job:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        ScriptLocation: script.py
  Nested:
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::Stack
    Properties:
      TemplateURL: nested.yaml
      Parameters:
        A: !GetAtt Job.Arn
  Fn:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Code: s3://code/key.zip
      Role: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::role'
  SM:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      DefinitionS3Location: sm.json
Outputs:
  O:
    Value: !If [IsProd, !Ref Api, !Join ['', [a, !Select [0, !GetAZs '']]]]
